rules.name: gate-before-push
rules.law: Autonomous push is not unaudited push. Every wave that changes running code may run node scripts/pre-push-review.mjs before git push; exit 1 = stop and fix before pushing.

rules.name: lazy-skills
rules.law: Skill INDEX (name+description) enters the prompt first; full bodies load only for skills the router picks. Never paste all skill bodies by default — token honesty (learned from openreview loadSkill).

rules.name: verdict-or-record
rules.law: Every gate run ends in a machine-readable verdict (pass|block|error) written to sovereign/review-gate/last-review.json. Silence is not a verdict.

rules.name: problem-why-fix-with-citations
rules.law: Findings must cite file:line and give problem, why it matters, and a concrete fix. Style nitpicks are forbidden findings (from openreview prompt craft).

rules.name: own-llm-only
rules.law: The gate reviews through llm-bridge (:3048, z-ai backend). No Anthropic key, no third-party review API. Aligns with MAG-2 bridge-not-keys.

rules.name: gate-fails-open-not-stuck
rules.law: Bridge/parse failure = verdict=error, recorded, exit 0. The gate must never deadlock autonomous pushes (D-OP-01: never wait for the operator). Block only on explicit blocker findings.

rules.name: license-clean-skills
rules.law: Skill content with no license (openreview itself, vercel-labs/next-skills) is distilled in our own words, never copied verbatim. MIT sources (vercel-labs/agent-skills) may be vendored with attribution.

activationRoutes.how: node scripts/pre-push-review.mjs --source staged|worktree|last-commit before git push
activationRoutes.evidence: r167: bad seed blocked (4 blockers, 9468ms); clean seed passed (1054ms, selective 1-of-2 skill load)

activationRoutes.how: external GitHub PR review needs GitHub App + public webhook URL
activationRoutes.blocked: sandbox has no public webhook endpoint; revisit if repo goes public with PRs

whyNotRevenue: Gate is quality infrastructure: fewer broken pushes → more autonomous cycles per day → indirect revenue protection. Same class as fleet-manifests-audit (r164), not a money path itself.
